subject: Multiple gheatmaps for a circular tree

messages.author: 8f9fd7b5b9d8dbba
messages.subject: Multiple gheatmaps for a circular tree
parts:
Hi

I am annotating a circular tree and I am interested in putting two different gheatmaps on it (one with numerical data and the other with categorical data). I am able to run each one individually but I cannot combine them in the same figure. I was wondering if that is possible?

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: Multiple gheatmaps for a circular tree
parts:
multiple gheatmap is supported see example in https://github.com/GuangchuangYu/ggtree/issues/78#issuecomment-252172314.
